title: The Drunken Master
description:
The Drunken Master is a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2: a brewer who mixes drinks mid-combat and then drinks them.

[h2]How he plays[/h2]
Play [b]Ingredient[/b] cards to fill a three-slot Brew. When the pot is full it seals into a [b]Concoction[/b]: a real potion built from the three Ingredients' effects. Brew Ethanol into a drink and knock it back to gain [b]Intoxication[/b]. Tipsy gives Strength and Dexterity, Drunk trades Dexterity for more Strength, and at high bands your card costs get randomized. Sober is when you brew; drunk is when you spend.

[h2]Keywords and mechanics[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Ingredient[/b]: a card that, when played, adds its effect to your Brew instead of doing it now. There are 12 kinds; cards, relics and potions can create them.
[*] [b]Brew[/b]: your pot of Ingredients. It holds 3 by default (some powers change that). When it is full it seals into a Concoction. The pot empties at the end of combat.
[*] [b]Concoction[/b]: a potion made of the sealed Ingredients' effects, stacked. Drinking it does all of them at once. A Concoction you have not drunk vanishes at the end of combat.
[*] [b]Ethanol[/b]: the Ingredient that gets you drunk. A Concoction containing it grants Intoxication when drunk. Drinking a potion grants nothing by itself.
[*] [b]Intoxication[/b]: a resource shown as a dial above the character. It starts every combat at 3, builds from Ethanol and specific cards, and resets after combat. Some cards cost Intoxication instead of Energy. The bands:
[*] [b]Sober[/b] (0 to 3): no bonus, and Intoxication does not fade. Several cards only work while Sober.
[*] [b]Tipsy[/b] (4 to 7): you have 1 Strength and 1 Dexterity. Fades by 1 each turn.
[*] [b]Drunk[/b] (8 to 11): you have 2 Strength and -1 Dexterity, and your cards get random costs (0 to 3) each turn. Fades by 2 each turn.
[*] [b]Blackout[/b] (12): at the end of your turn, play the top 3 cards of your draw pile, reset Intoxication to 0, and wake Hungover.
[*] [b]Hungover[/b]: next turn, gain 1 less Energy and draw 1 fewer card. Some cards get stronger while you are Hungover.
[*] [b]Poised[/b]: this card's cost is never randomized by being Drunk.
[*] [b]Confusion[/b]: an enemy debuff. Each hit of that enemy's attacks deals 1 less damage per stack, and the damage removed is dealt to the enemy instead. Wears off at the end of its turn.
[/list]

[h2]Contents[/h2]
[list]
[*] 80 class cards (20 Common, 35 Uncommon, 25 Rare) plus 12 Ingredients
[*] 9 relics and 3 character potions
[*] Custom card, relic and character art, energy gem and character select screen
[*] Works in co-op as long as every player runs the same mod version
[/list]

[h2]Requirements[/h2]
[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3737335127]BaseLib[/url] (subscribe to it too)
[*] The [b]public-beta[/b] branch of the game, v0.111.0 or newer. The mod is built against the beta API and will not load on the current main branch (v0.107.1). In Steam: right-click Slay the Spire 2 > Properties > Betas > public-beta.
[/list]

[h2]Status[/h2]
Early release. Balance is still being tuned, and a few UI pieces (rest site and merchant animations, some icons) are placeholders. Feedback and bug reports are welcome in the comments.
changeNote:
Balance pass on the Brew powers, plus a rework of Iron Liver. Thanks again to Loomder for the feedback.

[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Shot Glass reworked: your Brew still holds 1 fewer Ingredient, but Ingredients now cost 1 more Intoxication to play (stacks per copy) instead of granting Intoxication when you drink a Concoction. The upgrade makes it cost 0 Energy. Cards that add Ingredients straight to the pot are not taxed.
[*] Stir Crazy now deals its damage once, then again for each Ingredient in your Brew, so it is never a dead draw on an empty pot.
[*] Stockpot now costs 2 and also grants 2 (3) Strength and 2 (3) Dexterity. The upgrade no longer reduces its cost.
[*] Iron Liver reworked: 2 Energy (upgrade 1). If you end your turn Drunk, your Block is not removed at the start of your next turn. Replaces the Vigor-per-drink version.
[/list]
[h3]Removed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dregs. A Concoction you have not drunk when combat ends now simply vanishes; the potion text and the Brew tooltip say so.
[/list]
Pool: 20 Common / 35 Uncommon / 25 Rare (80 cards).
